hypothesis: A 0.10 beta relaxation of the original Stage1 cap can have a fee-net local value that differs from the closed five-session cash prediction task. Before fitting any receiver, construct its matched physical-account target only on the saved 2018-2022 OOF training reference.
parent_boundary: Saved original-architecture OOF 2018-2022 0bp Tiered account is a training scaffold. A later held economic candidate must keep frozen full Stage1 f696 allocator plus b472 action/risk/recovery, own funded 0bp account, and SOXX hard gate.
clock_and_eligibility: At 09:46, raw beta=3*saved raw SOXL weight+saved raw SOXX weight. Eligible only if raw beta exceeds own-state cap by >=0.10 and original open controller EXECUTE. This mask uses no 09:47 price or future return. The last training date without next-session reset stays label-unknown.
paired_label: From identical saved pre-09:47 adjusted quantities, cash and monthly Tiered share-count state, branch A executes the original projected target; branch B executes the same raw Stage1 target projected with own-state cap+0.10, unchanged 15% cash floor and 30% SOXL max. Both use observed 09:47 adjusted/raw execution marks, whole raw shares, sells-first funding and 0bp added slippage with frozen IBKR Tiered fees. At the following Qlib session 09:47 both branches separately rebalance to the same saved next-session original projected target with independently carried fee counters. Label=(B NAV after common reset-A NAV after common reset)/pre-branch NAV. Available only at next-session 09:49. This one-step local label does not propagate either branch risk state or holdings to further sessions.
validation: Assert exact Qlib 1061-day calendar and source identities, original projected-target parity, original continuous cash/share ledger parity, equal branch initial state and fee counters, legal funded orders, finite branch NAV and deterministic next-session reset. Keep all 1061 calendar rows with unknown ineligible/end labels. Record annual support and descriptive sign/mean without selecting a policy. Do not read 2023+ outcomes.
cost_scope: The tariff is the frozen 2026-10-13 IBKR Pro Tiered projection applied over saved history, not actual historical broker bills. No external spread/latency proof beyond the frozen price plane.
stop: If original ledger or projection parity, branch funding, next-session reset, source hash, native calendar, or NAS receipt/readback fails, record the precise failure and stop. No receiver fit or held account in this card. A later receiver/control/annual gate must be frozen before any fitting; 2019/2021 support is thin.
